Dream 2026-11-22 linked 5 vignettes from 3 days to this record as evidence. Agree if they belong here; disagree to have a later dream drop them.

- 2026-10-25 · retells · "The narrative is the initial semantic later, it's the experience in the moment that is then crystallised into structure." (A chat opens a container: the narrative is the initial semantic layer (2026-10-25))
- 2026-10-25 · touches · "these conversations will be created by Mcp when I chat with any other AI. They are my own chat artifacts." (Containers are boundaries: search within them; conversations are my chat artifacts (2026-10-25))
- 2026-10-25 · touches · "It should be something agents manage without me needing to tell them. When a conversation begins to describe a problem and remedy" (Narrative practice must be default: agents act on problem and remedy talk unprompted (2026-10-25))
- 2026-11-05 · touches · "there is rarely much value in every utterance as a record" (Raw conversation is provenance below the vignettes; we pull out fragments and export only the key bits (2026-11-05))
- 2026-11-07 · touches · "if we discover ab issue that keeps coming back, eg: how do we write and store decisions... There is obviously a boundary there. But we sense it first." (A cluster is just another boundary; sensed boundaries are clarified after, declared boundaries are held before looking inside (2026-11-07))
